answer: The summit explorer makes public the whole merge tree. Splitting into 6 separate vaults requires a separate funded plume account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and therefore the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the marble binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A farm of 47 pays that 177 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
